description: Matcher regression cases from the 2026-10-05 capture. 'expected' comes from human review, not from the matcher. Rejected cases must stay D. Positive cases record CURRENT matcher behaviour for reviewer-checked candidates pending owner review; they are not confirmed production matches.

cases.name: m53-j8-j9-entry-slips
cases.review: M53 northbound J8 and J9 entry slip-road closures (same situation); main carriageway open. Both were false positives in the per-record prototype.

cases.name: m1-j12-entry-slip
cases.review: Entry slip closure encoded with main-carriageway links closed at the merge.

cases.name: a1-colsterworth-layby
cases.review: Layby closure encoded as main carriageway closed with 0 lanes open.

cases.name: m1-j11a-to-j13
cases.review: Closure extends beyond the J11-J12 stretch.

cases.name: m5-j3-to-j4a
cases.review: Closure extends beyond the J3-J4 stretch (J4-J4A links closed the same night).

cases.name: m60-within-j21
cases.review: Closure inside J21 between its slips; J20-J21 route would leave a junction early.

cases.name: a42-j11-to-j13-continues-from-m42
cases.review: Found by the strict matcher's first run: closure continues from M42 onto A42; an M42-only fragment matched M42 J10-J11.

cases.name: a42-j13-to-m1-j23a
cases.review: Found by the strict matcher's first run: A42 closure into M1 J23a; M1-only fragment matched M1 J23A-J24.

cases.name: m65-j7-to-j8-eastbound

cases.name: m54-j1-to-m6-j10a-eastbound
cases.review: Expected D under approved D7: NH closure text and the S4 stretch label say J1, but route M54/J1/M6/J10A/2 traces from the M54 J2 node, so the labels can't be reconciled with the path. Position-precise E6 (D9) alone would not change it: the closed section starts ~53 m before the J1 node (0 lanes open), so the junction before the closure is J2.
